title: Intake generation
description: B1: the effective configuration of the intake service, as generation.json in its own directory of the generations volume. Intake adopts a new generation in place.

generation.description: The generation number. A higher number replaces a lower one.

status_url.description: Where the service reports its status to the control plane.

status_interval_s.description: How often the service reports its status, in seconds.

database.description: Where intake signs in to the database, as its own role.

worlds.description: The worlds whose telemetry intake takes, by the Compose service name of each world's container: a batch is taken only from the address Docker's DNS gives that name.
